records.text: Owens described unverified theories alleging Dando had been investigating the Yugoslav war or a BBC pedophile network including Jimmy Savile; she presented them as claims by others.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And the murder has been at the center of a lot of conspiracy theories since people alleging that at the time of her murder, she was working on a story about former UK. ... more Yugoslavia, what was going on with that war, as well as many people who claim that she was actually investigating a pedophile network at the BBC, which included Jimmy Savile.
